messages:
Ravi: quick update from cedar bring-up (256d, per-tensor int6 candidate). throughput looks great but quality flags on semantic-sim tests.
Lina: what metric deltas are we seeing? rough numbers ok.
Ravi: wiki-holdout recall@10 baseline (fp16) = 0.879 -> cedar-int6 = 0.846 ( -0.033 ). recall@1 drop ~0.018. cluster purity down 0.04. mean cosine shift ~= 0.021.
Diego: that recall@10 drop is non-trivial. do we have neighbor-stability / anchor metrics?
Taylor: ran anchor-stability (k=3) on the full holdout: anchor-flip rate 11% overall; for tail cohort ~15%. also observed "semantic islanding" where a compact cluster splits into two nearby clusters post-quant.
Lina: semantic islanding = noisy boundaries after quantization. did you try index-normalize prior to HNSW build?
Ravi: index was built from raw vectors. quick normalizing sample recovered ~1.3% recall on the wiki sample.
Diego: interesting. could be that per-tensor scales are not capturing per-dim variance. try per-channel quant6 or per-channel int6 with bias-correction.
Taylor: also try post-quant scale recalibration using a small calibration set (10k examples). small gains usually, but worth it.
Ravi: triage plan I'm proposing: 1) run per-channel int6 sweep (vs per-tensor) 2) post-quant recalib w/ 10k calibration set 3) index-time L2 normalize + rebuild indices 4) hybrid-anchor store (top-32 anchors stored fp16) 5) run asymmetric-quant residual (store small residuals fp8) as an experiment
embed-ci: embed-eval job triggered by @Ravi: id=e-9217. runs=[wiki-holdout, tail-cohort, short-query], metrics=[recall@1,recall@5,recall@10,anchor-stability(k=1,3,10),cluster-purity,cosine-shift]. ETA ~40m.
Lina: operational note: if normalization recovers >1.5% and per-channel recovers another ~1% we might accept a 0.5% net drop for 1.6x cost savings, but prefer rollback path documented.
Diego: rollback options: - keep fp16 for anchor-index (hybrid) - deploy quant variant to canary with aggressive rerank top-k - fall back to fp16 routing when detect short-query cohort hits error budget
Taylor: I'll kick off per-channel sweep and the calibration job. Ravi can start hybrid-anchor smoke on a small index shard.
Ravi: starting hybrid smoke now on shard-a. will post smoke logs and quick PR metrics here when ready.
Taylor: also note to product: include a flag in model catalog to mark "anchors fp16" to make hybrid rollouts easy.
Ravi: will update the model catalog draft after tests. will not promote cedar-int6 to staging until we see recovery >=2% or hybrid path validated.
Lina: thanks everyone. ping if the embed-ci job finishes or if you need dedicated node for hybrid smoke.
